title: Physics Inspired Neural Networks Enable Efficient Graph Coloring
abstract: arXiv:2408.01503v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Combinatorial optimization problems near algorithmic phase transitions represent a fundamental challenge for both classical algorithms and machine learning approaches. Among them, graph coloring is a prototypical constraint satisfaction problem characterized by phase transitions that fragment the solution space into distinct clusters, making the search for valid solutions challenging. Here we introduce a physics-inspired neural framework that learns to solve large-scale graph coloring instances by combining graph neural networks with statistical-mechanics principles. Our approach integrates a planting-based supervised signal, symmetry-breaking regularization, and iterative noise-annealed neural dynamics to navigate complex solution landscapes. translated_title: 物理启发的神经网络实现高效图着色
translated_abstract: 处于算法相变附近的组合优化问题对经典算法和机器学习方法都构成了根本性挑战。其中，图着色是一个典型的约束满足问题，其特征在于相变会将解空间分割成多个不同的簇，使得寻找有效解变得极具挑战性。本文提出了一种物理启发的神经框架，通过将图神经网络与统计力学原理相结合来学习求解大规模图着色实例。该方法整合了基于种植的监督信号、对称性破缺正则化以及迭代噪声退火的神经动力学，以在复杂的解空间景观中导航。当迭代次数与图规模呈二次方缩放时，学习到的求解器能够成功处理日益困难的实例，即使是在寻找有效解变得极为困难的区域中依然有效。
tldr: 该研究提出一种结合图神经网络与统计力学原理的物理启发神经框架，通过监督信号、对称性破缺正则化和噪声退火神经动力学，实现对大规模图着色问题的高效求解。
en_tdlr: This work introduces a physics-inspired neural framework that combines graph neural networks with statistical mechanics principles to efficiently solve large-scale graph coloring instances near phase transitions.
